info.title: veo-3.1-lite-generate-preview API
info.description: Create Veo 3.1 Lite video generation tasks, supporting text-to-video, first-frame image-to-video and first-and-last-frame image-to-video

post.description:
- Veo 3.1 Lite (veo-3.1-lite-generate-preview) is the low-cost tier of the Veo 3.1 family and supports text-to-video, first-frame image-to-video and first-and-last-frame image-to-video; output is `4`, `6` or `8` seconds at `720p` or `1080p`, with audio generated by default
- Compared with Veo 3.1 Fast and Veo 3.1 Pro, Lite does not support reference images (`REFERENCE` mode) or `4k` output. The model is in Preview and currently supports English prompts only
- Billing: each generated video is billed by its output duration; the per-second rate depends on the resolution (`720p` / `1080p`) and on whether audio is generated. See [EvoLink model pricing](https://evolink.ai/models/veo-3-1-lite) for prices
- Asynchronous processing: use the returned task ID to [query task status](/en/api-manual/task-management/get-task-detail)
- Generated video links are valid for 24 hours, please save them promptly

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the video to generate, max `2000` tokens. Write the prompt in English: the model currently supports English prompts only (Preview)
prompt.example: A golden retriever puppy running through a sunlit meadow, slow motion, cinematic lighting

image_urls.description:
Input image URLs for image-to-video

**Notes:**
- Up to `2` images per request: `1` image is used as the first frame, `2` images are used as the first and last frames
- Reference images are not supported by this model; requests with `3` or more images are rejected
- Image size: no larger than `20MB`
- Supported file formats: `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.png`, `.webp`

generation_type.description:
Generation mode. When omitted it is inferred from the number of images; when set it must match the number of images, otherwise the request is rejected with `400`

- `TEXT_2_VIDEO`: text-to-video, no images
- `FIRST_FRAME_2_VIDEO`: first-frame image-to-video, `1` image
- `FIRST_AND_LAST_FRAMES_2_VIDEO`: first-and-last-frame image-to-video, `2` images

`REFERENCE_2_VIDEO` (reference images) is not supported by this model and is rejected

aspect_ratio.description: Video aspect ratio, default `16:9`. `auto` is not supported by this model

generate_audio.description: Whether to generate audio, default `true`. Generating audio increases the per-second rate

duration.description: Video duration in seconds, default `4`. Longer videos cost more

n.description: Number of videos to generate, default `1`. Each video is billed separately

quality.description: Output resolution, default `720p`. `1080p` has a higher per-second rate; `4k` is not supported by this model

seed.description: Random seed for reproducing a generation

negative_prompt.description: Negative prompt describing what should not appear in the video

callback_url.description:
HTTPS callback URL for task completion

**Callback Timing:**
- Triggered when task is completed, failed, or cancelled
- Sent after billing confirmation

**Security Restrictions:**
- HTTPS protocol only
- Internal IP addresses are prohibited (127.0.0.1, 10.x.x.x, 172.16-31.x.x, 192.168.x.x, etc.)
- URL length must not exceed `2048` characters

**Callback Mechanism:**
- Timeout: `10` seconds
- Maximum `3` retries after failure (at `1`/`2`/`4` seconds after failure)
- Callback response format is consistent with task query API
- 2xx status code is considered successful, other codes trigger retry

can_cancel.description: Whether the task can be cancelled (tasks for this model cannot be cancelled after submission)

estimated_time.description: Estimated completion time in seconds. Actual time depends on the queue

video_duration.description: Video duration in seconds, equal to the requested `duration`

billing_rule.description: Billing rule. This model uses `per_call`: the charge for each call is settled from the output duration of every returned video, at a per-second rate determined by resolution and audio. See [EvoLink model pricing](https://evolink.ai/models/veo-3-1-lite) for actual prices

credits_reserved.description: Estimated credit usage (pre-authorization), calculated from `duration`, `quality`, `generate_audio` and `n`. Final usage is settled after task completion based on the videos actually returned; refer to your bill for the final amount

## All APIs require Bearer Token authentication ##

**Get API Key:**

Visit [API Key Management Page](https://evolink.ai/dashboard/keys) to get your API Key

**Add to request header:**
```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```
